### Copied to clipboardMigration Considerations

Moving from NGINX to an alternative involves several factors beyond feature comparison: [...] Pros:

 API gateway features included that NGINX OSS lacks, such as active health checks and dynamic reconfiguration without reload
 Kong Manager GUI addresses NGINX's lack of a management interface
 Consumer-aware rate limiting and authentication
 Strong plugin ecosystem for API management use cases

Cons:

 Additional complexity layer on top of NGINX
 Enterprise features (active health checks, JWT authentication, OIDC, SAML, dynamic reconfiguration API) require NGINX Plus paid tiers
 Overkill for simple reverse proxy or web serving
 Learning curve for Lua-based plugin development
